body.prose:
Yes, we are laying the foundation not making the resume website, making everything as real and first class as possible, so that when we build a site we have an [OpenLight]-successor experience.

Of course it is good to write what is settled instead of just implementing of the session, but do we know how the store works? Because perhaps we can put all the spec we are settling here directly in the store.
body.title: The foundation, not the site
